youtube.aciklama: The typical sign of noise-induced hearing loss is a notch between 3 and 6 kHz with partial recovery at 8 kHz. Age-related loss does not show this recovery; thresholds keep worsening toward 8 kHz.

cumleler: How do you spot noise-induced hearing loss on an audiogram?
The typical sign is a notch between three and six thousand hertz.
At eight thousand hertz, thresholds recover again.
Age-related loss shows no such recovery; thresholds keep worsening.
